plate_comment: The TPE charge temperature estimate (e2m 1A1A / 1A1B): the compressor inlet temperature reference from the alpha / chi maps; charge_temperature_estimate = filtered (compressor inlet temperature - reference) x gain + offset terms; its status (was cm848_processBoostProtectionMode)
Seeds the charge temperature estimate filter and its status byte (was cm848_initBoostProtectionState)

compressor_inlet_density (e2m 18E8 +0 Compressor_Inlet_Density): compressor inlet pressure x 2936512 / the absolute compressor inlet temperature, slew limited; the density-based limit tables read it (was cm848_calculateAmbientAirDensity) | earlier note: Ambient air density input for the density-based limit tables: barometric_pressure_selected (compressor_inlet_pressure) x 2936512 / ((ambient air temperature + 29440) x 128), i.e. pressure over absolute temperature (29440 = 460 degF x 64), capped at 65535, then moved toward it by at most compressor_inlet_density_positive_rate_limit / _lower per pass into ambient_air_density (the first pass jumps straight to it). Also sets DAT_0040a606 to 2 when both input states are 2, 0 when both are 0, else 1. (was cm848_mainLoop_step_2)

Chooses compressor_inlet_temperature (e2m 1A0C +0): the channel 20 sensor or its default by the sensor fault status, with compressor_inlet_temperature_source (was cm848_selectAmbientAirTemperatureInput) | earlier note: Chooses the ambient air temperature input: sensor_channel20_value (ambient_air_temperature_sensor_filtered) into ambient_air_temperature_selected with ambient_air_temperature_selected_source = 0, or sensor_channel20_default_value with state 2 when the channel fault status or one of the gated fault bits is set (gates in fuel_timing_demand_fault_gate_enable). (was cm848_communication_periodic)

Boot pass of the compressor inlet temperature input: the source from the channel 20 fault status and the first value (was cm848_initializeAmbientAirTemperatureInput) | earlier note: Boot pass of the ambient air temperature input: ambient_air_temperature_selected_source from sensor_channel20_fault_status (0 or 1 -> 0, 2 -> 2) and ambient_air_temperature_selected = sensor_channel20_value. (was cm848_initialization_step_10)
